'''Talaan''' is a young [[Sea Folk]] [[Windfinder]] apprentice.

== Appearance ==
She is very slim, without a womanly figure, and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] thinks at first that she is about fourteen. But she is older than Nynaeve first thought, because she is nineteen years old, and her younger appearance is probably due to [[slowing]]. She has no nose ring yet and has one earring in the left ear and three in the right.

==Abilities==
Talaan is one of the strongest living channelers. Nynaeve believes that Talaan has tremendous potential and could overpower her with a little more experience. Talaan also once [[shielding|shielded]] Nynaeve from the [[One Power]], at the command of [[Zaida]]{{ref/book|9|11}}.

According to [[The Wheel of Time Companion]], her current strength is {{opsl|10}}, the same as [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]'s, while her potential is a level above Nynaeve's at {{opsl|8}}. This potential is stronger than any Aes Sedai we know of since the founding of the White Tower, surpassed only by [[Lanfear]] and [[Semirhage]]. Talaan is at a level that would have been exceptionally strong, even in the [[Age of Legends]]. The Forsaken [[Mesaana]] and novice [[Sharina Melloy]] are her equals in potential.

==History==
She is the daughter of [[Caire din Gelyn Running Wave]] and the niece of [[Tebreille din Gelyn South Wind]]. She was born in {{Ne|981}}. 

She is extremely strong in the [[One Power]], with a potential that either matches or surpasses Nynaeve's own, and Nynaeve is one of the most powerful female channelers in this Age.

There is a feud between her mother and her aunt which makes her ask Nynaeve, her tutor, whether she could be a [[novice]] at the [[White Tower]]{{ref/book|9|11}}.

She explains to Nynaeve that Gelyn family is blessed with many high-ranking members in Sea Folk society. Five of Talaan's family members are Windfinders to Sea Folk Clans. This, however, causes others to be suspicious that perhaps the Gelyn family is abusing its power. Because of this, Talaan is punished for doing things she did not do, or for being too slow when she is going as fast as she can. She realizes that she will be held back for several years, just so that no one can think that she is being favored. Since Talaan became an apprentice, her mother had never once acknowledged by word, deed, facial expression or tone of voice that she was her daughter. Thus, Talaan becomes convinced that being a novice would be an easier life for her. 

==Activities==
=== Apprentice ===
Talaan goes to the [[Tarasin Palace]] with many windfinders{{ref/book|7|37}} to meet with Nynaeve, Elayne, and Mat.

She [[Traveling|Travels]] with the the rest of the group led by Nynaeve and [[Elayne Trakand]] from [[Ebou Dar]] to the [[Kin]]'s [[farm]] with the [[Bowl of the Winds]]{{ref/book|8|1}}{{ref/book|8|3}}. She is part of the thirteen women who [[link]] and channel into the Bowl of the Winds to change the weather. She used also the amber turtle angreal{{ref/book|8|5}}. 

From the Farm Talaan travels to, and across, Andor. After that, she arrives at the Royal Palace with the others{{ref/book|8|6}}{{ref/book|8|20}}{{ref/book|8|28}}. 

Nynaeve thinks that Talaan is extremely strong in the [[One Power]], with a potential that either matches or surpasses her own, and Nynaeve is one of the most powerful female channelers in this Age. During one of the lessons between them, Talaan shields Nynaeve twice{{ref/book|9|11}}.

=== Runaway ===
Talaan vanished, along with [[Merilille Ceandevin|Merilille Sedai]]. She most probably ran away with the Aes Sedai{{ref/book|10|14}}, where she came with [[Dragonsworn]] contingent. The Windfinders annoyed Elayne a lot about this fact. [[Chanelle]] even claims that Merilille has kidnapped Talaan, and thinks that Elayne is hiding them{{ref/book|11|14}}{{ref/book|11|22}}.

===Last Battle===

Talaan is seen in the [[Shayol Ghul]] battlefront by [[Aviendha]]. She fights [[Hessalam]] along with [[Amys]], [[Cadsuane]] and [[Alivia]] before the [[Forsaken]] goes after Aviendha{{ref/book|14|42}}.

It is presumed she survived like the other three.
